title: Supplementary material: Post-Quantum Key Establishment over MAVLink: Measured Cost and Integration Pitfalls of HQC on a Small UAV
description:
Supplementary material of the manuscript "Post-Quantum Key Establishment over MAVLink: Measured Cost and Integration Pitfalls of HQC on a Small UAV", submitted to IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems (resubmission of TAES-2026-2045).

It contains the scripts that recompute every capture-derived result of Sections VI and VII of the manuscript (Tables V and VI, Fig. 3) from the public packet captures, the standalone test programs and recorded outputs of the KEM tests (known-answer test, self-consistency and benchmarks on a PC, a Raspberry Pi Pico and an ESP32), the patch that implements the corrections for findings F2 to F6 together with the activation self-test, the MAVLink dialect message list, and the handshake transcript and key schedule as the flight-controller firmware computes them.

The evaluated firmware and the packet captures are not included: they are the ArduPilot fork at commit b402392 of cdcp2/ardupilot_post_quantum_kem (cloned with --recursive), which the manuscript cites. The ground-station software was not archived.
